title: Q-LOOPPROOF-1: the tick proves its loops ran and reads its own stage from bootstrap to criticality
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** every tick of ultrastable-tick (cron */10) and every site Worker tick (watchdog)
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/src/pulse.js::export async function pulseStep
**Status:** closed

Read from the live org database on 2026-11-15 19:00 UTC: k_eff 0.068 against k_min 1, 2 open ignition gaps, 127 of 144 ticks complete in 24 h (the criticality step failed on a table whose migration had not run, uncounted). The ten lane loops ran in one try block and wrote only to the console; the heartbeat had one producer; no record of the stage between bootstrap and criticality existed.

Acceptance: every lane loop runs inside beat() (seed/worker/src/pulse.js); tick step pulse writes loop_clock and files or closes MISSED-<loop>; the site Worker calls POST /pulse/watch and the tick Worker restarts a stale heartbeat; tick step ignition writes the stage, ignition_log and IGNITE-<stage>; the Worker carries the DDL of its new tables; GET /live on the tick Worker returns ignition and pulse.

size: M

**Closing probe:** GET https://ultrastable.io/health expect "watchdog":{"status":"ok"

**Evidence:** closing probe passed (first pass): grep:seed/worker/src/pulse.js::export async function pulseStep
